description: React component for managing user timezones in user settings, including automatic/manual timezone selection and updating user profile.

classes.name: ManageTimezones
classes.description: React component for managing user timezone settings, allowing toggle between automatic and manual timezone selection, and saving updates.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes component state based on props.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles change in timezone selection from ReactSelect.

methods.name: timezoneNotChanged
methods.description: Checks if timezone settings have changed from initial props.

methods.name: changeTimezone
methods.description: Triggers update or resets section if timezone hasn't changed.

methods.name: submitUser
methods.description: Sends updated user profile with timezone info to server.

methods.name: handleAutomaticTimezone
methods.description: Handles toggle of automatic timezone checkbox, updating state accordingly.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders timezone selection UI, including checkboxes and dropdowns.
